page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head above and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A gathering signature stands at the foot.

p.i: Maius esse per Deum, quàm per Euangelium iurare.

main_text.p: 22.q.1. Si aliqua. Si aliqua causa fuerit, modi cū videtur facere, qui iurat per Deū, qui autem per Euangelium, maius aliquid fecisse videtur; quibus dicendum est, Stulti, propter Deum scripturæ sanctæ sunt, nō Deus propter scripturas.

head.i: Illicita iuramenta & vota non esse servanda.

main_text.p: 22.q.4. Multis hoc agitur Capitibus, & inducuntur diuersa Herodis & Dauidis exempla. Ibidem etiam hæc testimonia citantur.
Isidorus in Synonymis lib. 2. In malis pro-missis resciinde[?] fidem, in turpi voto muta de-cretum, quod incautè vouisti, ne facias, impia est promissio, quæ scelere adimpletur.
Ambrosius de Officijs: Melius est non vouere, quàm vouere id, quod sibi is cui promittitur nolit exolui.
August. Magnæ sapientiæ est reuocare ho-minem, quod malè locutus est.
Concil. Elibertinum. Diffinitio incauta lau-dabiliter soluenda est, nec est prævaricatio, sed temeritatis emendatio.
August. Mulier si fide coniugali violata fi-dem feruet adultero, vtique mala est, porrò si eam flagitij pœnitéat, & ad castitatem redien[?]

page.notes: The first line at the top is a continuation of a rubric from the previous page. "redien[?]": the last word is cut off at the line end and the final letter is unclear. "resciinde[?]": the word looks like "rescinde" with an extra stroke; uncertain. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j were normalised. The "E" at the foot is treated as the gathering signature.
